title: 第26章  明礼扇赵衡
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
周通被噎了一下，脸色微变，眼前这人的身份可不一般。

    赵衡，镇魔校尉。

    并且是青州镇魔司最顶尖的几名校尉之一，同境之中能与其比肩的不过一手之数。

    威名赫赫，罕有敌手。

    周通第一次站在赵衡面前，是七年前的事。

    那时他刚拿到晋升镇魔卫的凭证，批栏里的“通过”二字是赵衡亲笔所写。

    从那之后，他便以赵衡的麾下自居。

    每当酒兴起时，总是会提一嘴他是赵大人亲自批核的镇魔卫，底气十足。

    赵衡从未回应过这种说法，也没否认过。

    所以，这不否认，也就被当作一种态度了。

    周通叹了口气，声音愈发恳切。

    “大人，像这种事情，司律堂向来是各打五十大板，若真报上去，吃亏的反而是我。”

    “我是您麾下的人，他连我都敢打，您若再不出手，只怕都没人能治他了。”

    赵衡手指从茶盏收回，目光微抬，正儿八经地看了周通一眼。

    “周通，你这套说辞，实在不怎么高明。”

    周通脸色从红转白，“大人，我——”

    “喝茶。”

    “不是，大人——”

    “请！”

    话音温和却没有丝毫软弱。

    周通脸色僵硬，刚到嘴边的话被硬生生咽了回去。

    将茶水一饮而尽，起身行了一礼，然后转身离去。

    赵衡将茶杯洗干净，倒扣在茶盘里。

    走到墙边铜盆洗了洗手，用布帛擦干，随后从抽屉中取出一本薄册子。

    翻开之后，在新入司的人员名录中找到了一个名字——陆渊。

    看了一眼，他从桌上取过一张洒金笺。

    展开，研磨，提笔。

    字迹端正清隽，一笔一划都透着多年功底。

    随后，他将洒金笺折好，放进一只素白信封，用蜡封口。

    “郑山。”

    赵衡声音不大，但很清晰。

    一名衙役从外走来，上前拱手。

    “赵大人，不知有何吩咐？”
content_en:
Zhou Tong was choked and his face changed slightly. The identity of the person in front of him was not ordinary.

    Zhao Heng, the Demon-Suppressing Colonel.

    He is also one of the top captains of the Qingzhou Demon-Suppressing Division, and only a handful of people in the same realm can compare with him.

    He is famous and has few rivals.

    The first time Zhou Tong stood in front of Zhao Heng was seven years ago.

    At that time, he had just received the certificate for promotion to Demon Suppressing Guard, and the word "passed" in the approval column was written by Zhao Heng himself.

    From then on, he regarded himself as Zhao Heng's subordinate.

    Whenever he gets drunk, he will always mention that he is a demon-suppressing guard personally approved by Mr. Zhao, and he is full of confidence.

    Zhao Heng has never responded to this statement, nor has he denied it.

    Therefore, if this is not denied, it is regarded as an attitude.

    Zhou Tong sighed, his voice becoming more sincere.

    "Sir, for things like this, Si Lutang has always dealt with fifty-fifty points. If we really report this, I will be the one who suffers."

    "I am your subordinate. He dares to hit me. If you don't take action, no one will be able to cure him."

    Zhao Heng withdrew his fingers from the tea cup, raised his eyes slightly, and looked at Zhou Tong seriously.

    "Zhou Tong, your rhetoric is really not very clever."

    Zhou Tong's face turned from red to pale, "Sir, I -"

    "Drink tea."

    "No, my lord——"

    "Please!"

    The words were gentle but not weak at all.

    Zhou Tong's face was stiff, and the words that came to his lips were swallowed back.

    He drank the tea in one gulp, stood up and bowed, then turned and left.

    Zhao Heng washed the tea cup and placed it upside down on the tea tray.

    He walked to the copper basin by the wall, washed his hands, dried them with a cloth, and then took out a thin book from the drawer.

    After opening it, I found a name in the directory of new employees - Lu Yuan.

    After taking a look, he took a piece of gold-sprinkled paper from the table.

    Unfold, grind, pick up the pen.

    The handwriting is neat and clear, and every stroke reveals years of skill.

    Then, he folded the gold-sprinkled paper, put it into a plain white envelope, and sealed it with wax.

    "Zheng Shan."

    Zhao Heng's voice was not loud, but very clear.

    A government official came from outside and stepped forward to give him his hand.

    "Master Zhao, do you have any orders?"
